properties.evidence: One is a hazard, the other answers it. That measurement found declared level and spine position returning different sets, with no way to say which is right. A fan-out rule gives an INDEPENDENT third signal that is neither: 101 components under one parent is a finding whether or not anyone declared a level, and it is the same finding under either reading. It does not resolve which source is authoritative — it removes the need to pick one in order to say something useful.
